## Activity

During July 2026, Central Eye Clinic completed 179 captures as part of its routine imaging activity. The recorded activity reflects the work completed by the clinic team during the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and no other operational issue is noted in the available report.

The activity record provides the basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes below. Captures that could not be assessed are reported separately to distinguish image-quality limitations from the grading results.

## Image quality

Of the 179 captures, 5 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.8 per cent. The result is presented for monitoring of image acquisition and to support ongoing review of the service.

## Grading

Grading identified 51 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. These results should be considered alongside the image-quality information, including the 5 ungradable captures, when reviewing the month’s overall screening activity.
